console.name: chaos
console.title: Chaos
console.description: The chaos rules and their report

enabled.description: Whether chaos is switched on: with profile dev or camel.chaos.enabled=true, never with profile prod

reason.description: Why chaos is off (only when it is off)

id.description: The id of the rule, such as r1

version.description: The version of the rule: 1 when added, one more each time it is changed

rule.description: The rule in its one-line text form

state.description: The state of the rule: active or ended

hooks.description: Where the rule fires: send, poll, entry or step

matches.description: The sends, polls, exchanges or steps the target of the rule matched

fired.description: The faults the rule fired, per hook

skipped.description: The faults that did nothing, as the rule fired at a message or an endpoint it cannot change

skippedReasons.description: Why the rule did nothing when it was skipped: the count per reason (only when it was skipped)

lostAtDlq.description: The messages lost because the rule failed or dropped the send of the dead letter channel, which then handled them (only for a rule with at=dlq)

endsIn.description: The milliseconds until an active rule ends

rate.description: The share of the matches the rule fires at: rate=, 1/N for rate=every:N, else 1 (not for a lifecycle or stall rule)

observedRate.description: The share of the matches the rule fired at so far, to compare with rate (once it matched; not for a lifecycle or stall rule)

nextFireIn.description: The matches until a rule with rate=every:N fires again (only for such a rule while it is active)

lastFiredAgo.description: The milliseconds since the rule last fired (only when it fired)

faultsLastMinute.description: The faults the rule fired in the last minute

faultsPerSecond.description: The faults the rule fired per second over the last minute, 60 counts from the oldest second to the current one (only when it fired in the last minute)

effect.description: The effect of the faults on the exchanges they hit (for a lifecycle or stall rule: the exchanges sent to its route while it was down), each counted once when it is done: faulted, completed, recovered (by a redelivery of the error handler), handled (by the error handler, such as the dead letter channel), failed and inFlight (only when the rule faulted an exchange)

expectation.description: The expectation of the rule (expect= and within=) and its outcome, when it has one

lifecycle.description: What a lifecycle or stall rule did to its route: action, route, duration, state (pending, acting, down, comingBack, back, skipped, left, failed or cancelled), downAt, backAt, backIn, endedEarly and reason (only for such a rule)

rules.description: The current rules (not the removed or replaced ones; only when chaos is on)

report.description: The report: verdict, final, seed, seedGiven, lost, reasons, all rules with the removed and replaced ones, the counts per route, and the recent faults (the last 20, the latest first: timestamp, ago, rule, version, fault, hook, route, endpoint or step, exchangeId) (only when chaos is on)
